records.jp: きららが読んでるの、占い雑誌？
records.en_original: What's that, Kirara? A fortune-telling magazine?
records.en: Kirara, is that a fortune-telling magazine you are reading?

records.jp: こういったものには紛い物も多い。<CR>不届き者はこの占い警察が成敗いたす
records.en_original: This is just garbage. As a member of the Cloister of Psychics, I will be filing an official complaint.
records.en: There are many frauds among publications like this.<CR>This fortune-telling police officer shall punish the insolent offenders.

records.jp: （好きで読むっていうより<CR>そういう目線で読んでるんだ）
records.en_original: (Guess she's not reading it for fun...)
records.en: (So rather than reading it because she likes it,<CR>she is examining it from that perspective.)

records.jp: 何読んでるんですか？<CR>……わぁ！　わたしにも見せてください！
records.en_original: What are you reading? Oh! May I see?
records.en: What are you reading?<CR>...Wow! Please let me see too!

records.jp: （あー、詩帆さん、こういうの好きそうだもんな）
records.en_original: (Ahh, I bet Shiho loves this kind of thing.)
records.en: (Ah, this does seem like the kind of thing Shiho-san would enjoy.)

records.jp: はぁ、恋愛占いの特集ですか
records.en_original: Fortune telling for love...?
records.en: Oh... A special feature on love fortunes?

records.jp: （詩さんは全然興味なさそうだな。<CR>これはこれでイメージ通り）
records.en_original: (I figured Uta wouldn't be interested.)
records.en: (Uta-san does not look interested at all.<CR>That is exactly as expected in its own way.)

records.jp: ね、せっかくですし、みんなでやりませんか？
records.en_original: Why don't we all give it a try? It could be fun!
records.en: Since we have the chance, why do we not all try it?

records.jp: こやつの真偽を見抜くいい機会。<CR>受けて立とう
records.en_original: Why not. This will be a good chance to see if this person is the real deal.
records.en: This is a fine opportunity to expose whether this thing is true or false.<CR>Kirara accepts the challenge.

records.jp: みなさんがやるなら
records.en_original: I suppose if everyone else is doing it...
records.en: If everyone else is doing it.

records.jp: えっと……「あなたは草原を飛び回る蝶です。<CR>３種類の綺麗な花が咲いています」
records.en_original: Okay...You're a butterfly flying around a meadow. There are three beautiful flowers in bloom.
records.en: Let us see... "You are a butterfly fluttering around a meadow.<CR>Three kinds of beautiful flowers are blooming."

records.jp: 「赤いチューリップ、青いアネモネ、黄色いフリージア<CR>の三択どれか選んでください」
records.en_original: A red tulip, a blue anemone, and a yellow freesia. Which do you choose?
records.en: "Choose one of the three:<CR>a red tulip, a blue anemone, or a yellow freesia."

records.jp: って、これどっちかっていうと心理テストじゃない？
records.en_original: Wait, isn't this just one of those personality quizzes?
records.en: Wait, is this not more of a personality test?

records.jp: 黄色いフリージア
records.en_original: The yellow freesia.
records.en: The yellow freesia.

records.jp: 青いアネモネで
records.en_original: I'll choose the blue anemone.
records.en: The blue anemone.

records.jp: うーん
records.en_original: Hmmm.
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: すっごい長考してる。<CR>勘でいいって書いてあるよ
records.en_original: Don't overthink it. It says just to go with your heart.
records.en: You are thinking about it for a very long time.<CR>It says your intuition is enough.

records.jp: 赤いチューリップでお願いします
records.en_original: The red tulip then.
records.en: The red tulip, please.

records.jp: 私は……
records.en_original: I'll go with...
records.en: I choose...

records.jp: 赤いチューリップかな
records.en_original: ...the red tulip I guess.
records.en: the red tulip, I guess.

records.jp: わたしと一緒ですね！
records.en_original: Same as me!
records.en: The same as me!

records.jp: これしか知らなかったってのもあるけど
records.en_original: It's also the only one of the three I've ever heard of.
records.en: Though part of it is that this is the only one I knew.

records.jp: 他はチューリップほどメジャーではないですもんね
records.en_original: The others aren't quite as well known, I believe.
records.en: The others are not as well known as tulips.

records.jp: わたしも結局馴染み深さで選びました
records.en_original: I chose the one I was most familiar with as well.
records.en: In the end, I chose based on familiarity too.

records.jp: 黄色いフリージアかな
records.en_original: ...the yellow freesia?
records.en: the yellow freesia, I guess.

records.jp: ふむ、きららと同じか
records.en_original: Heh, same as me, huh?
records.en: Hmm, the same as Kirara.

records.jp: なんか黄色い花の方がテンション上がるかなって思って
records.en_original: Yellow flowers just seem so bright and happy.
records.en: I thought yellow flowers might lift my mood more.

records.jp: 風水的にも良い。そういう意味ではきららも同じ理由
records.en_original: It's also good feng shui. That's why I chose it.
records.en: They are also good according to feng shui. In that sense, Kirara chose it for the same reason.

records.jp: 青いアネモネかな
records.en_original: ...the blue anemone.
records.en: the blue anemone, I guess.

records.jp: 私と同じですね
records.en_original: I chose the same
records.en: The same as me.

records.jp: 青い花って黄色い花とか赤い花よりはあまり見かけない<CR>気がしない？　ただの体感だけど
records.en_original: I feel like blue flowers are rarer that yellow or red ones. No idea if that's true though.
records.en: Do blue flowers not seem less common than yellow or red ones?<CR>That is only my impression, though.

records.jp: わかります。<CR>せっかくならレアなお花がいいですよね
records.en_original: I agree. If I had the choice, I'd prefer the rarest flower.
records.en: I understand.<CR>If we are choosing, a rare flower would be nice.

records.jp: で、えーと……「この占いでわかるのは<CR>あなたの好きな男性のタイプです」
records.en_original: Let's see... This divination tells you what to look for in a partner.
records.en: And, um... "This fortune reveals<CR>the type of man you like."

records.jp: 「赤いチューリップを選んだあなたは<CR>包容力がある優しい男性がタイプ」
records.en_original: Those who chose the red tulip look for a kind and patient partner.
records.en: "If you chose the red tulip,<CR>your type is a kind, broad-minded man."

records.jp: 包容力があって優しい……
records.en_original: Kind and patient...
records.en: Broad-minded and kind...

records.jp: 当たってるかも……
records.en_original: I think they may be right...
records.en: It might be right...

records.jp: 「青いアネモネを選んだあなたは知らない世界を<CR>見せてくれる刺激的な男性を求めがち」
records.en_original: Those who chose the blue anemone look for an adventurous partner that will introduce them to new things.
records.en: "If you chose the blue anemone, you tend to seek an exciting man<CR>who will show you a world you do not know."

records.jp: たしかにそういう男性がいたら<CR>興味を持ってしまうかもしれません
records.en_original: I believe I would be interested in someone like that.
records.en: If such a man existed,<CR>I might indeed become interested in him.

records.jp: 「黄色いフリージアを選んだあなたは一緒に<CR>ふざけられるような気兼ねない男性がぴったり」
records.en_original: Those who chose the yellow freesia look for a partner they can feel at ease around and can joke with.
records.en: "If you chose the yellow freesia, the perfect match is a man<CR>you can fool around with without holding back."

records.jp: 気兼ねない……
records.en_original: Feel at ease...
records.en: Without holding back...

records.jp: まぁ、当たってなくもない
records.en_original: I suppose it's not wrong, exactly.
records.en: Well, it is not entirely wrong.

records.jp: なんかみんな様子が変だけど、<CR>特定の誰か思い浮かべちゃってたり？
records.en_original: What's with you all? Are you thinking of someone in particular?
records.en: Everyone is acting a little strange.<CR>Did a particular person come to mind?

records.jp: 違います！
records.en_original: No!
records.en: No!

records.jp: 少なくとも詩帆ときららは同じ人かも
records.en_original: I think Shiho and I may be thinking of the same person.
records.en: At least Shiho and Kirara may be thinking of the same person.

records.jp: ちょっと！
records.en_original: Hey!
records.en: Hey!

records.jp: っ！　今……
records.en_original: Just now, I...
records.en: ...! Just now...

records.jp: なんて、気のせいですよね
records.en_original: I'm sure it's nothing.
records.en: No... It must have been a trick of the mind.
